ordered_branches.explanation: Globally normalizes fixed placeholder strings, zeros numeric user defaults and deletes rows with warehouse/item/allocation-location allNULL. Duplicate grouping includes quantity UM but diagnostic grouping omits it; grouped assignment can retain a prior count if no rows. Existing-assignment check joins location/item/null-normalized company without matching target warehouse. Checks single-item location conflicts, including permanent inventory; one LOCATION join uses location text only. Missing warehouse/location, duplicate/conflict errors set validation failure; missing item/company only tags source stamps, and invalid UM only warns. Some validation scans all warehouses against the selected warehouse location set. On success globally deletes Staging_ILA, inserts only selected warehouse conversion rows, then fills NULL stamps. No atomicity or source deletion after load.
